newsitem.title: USA: US corporate debt focuses on issues, US 30-yr roll.
newsitem.headline: US corporate debt focuses on issues, US 30-yr roll.

text.p: U.S. high-grade corporate debt prices came off with U.S. Treasuries into mid-session, while players focused nearly $1.0 billion issuance, dealers said.

Secondary trade was quiet with spreads flat except for company specific news, traders said. Dealers said the Street was braced for some long-end selling upon completion of the 30-year T-bond auction and subsequent roll by corporates.

Topping new issuance, Korea Development Bank issued $500 million seven-year 6-5/8 percent debt at 99.528 to yield 49 basis points over the U.S. Treasury curve. The bonds are rated A1 by Moody's and AA-minus by Standard & Poor's.
